items.q: even George Benson used to come down there and play with me. He's a good friend....

ctx.x: Did you know Don Byas well?

...We worked across the street from each other -- When he was in town a few years ago I was playing at a place called the Barron ... on Lenox Avenue and 134, 135th ... it was a heck of a club, there. We had all the big musicians, even George Benson used to come down there and play with me. He's a good friend....
